text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having deemed that both her ability and physique are at a sufficient level, I've chosen to enter Mejiro Ardan in the Satsuki Sho. Even before her first-ever classic G1 race, she looks incredibly composed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing that Mejiro Ardan quietly harbors a fervent desire to win, Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O find their own competitive spirit suddenly ignited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The great battle that is the Satsuki Sho—the first race of the Classic Triple Crown—is about to unfold!
